description:
Because:

- 19 packages in fxa-content-server package.json have no use after the Backbone removals.

This commit:

- Removes 4 dependencies and 15 devDependencies from fxa-content-server.
- Updates yarn.lock to drop the entries that only these packages needed.
- Keeps @types/backbone, which tsc needs for the backbone import.

Closes FXA-14817
